tool_input.command:
python3 - <<'EOF'
import re
h=open('game.html').read()
m=re.search(r'<script>\n(.*)\n</script>', h, re.S)
js=m.group(1)
open('/tmp/full.js','w').write(js)
# core = everything before section 9 UI
i=js.index('   9. UI')
core=js[:js.rindex('/* =====',0,i)]
open('/tmp/core.js','w').write(core+"\n\nglobalThis.document={documentElement:{innerHTML:'no rand here'}};\nconst out=runTests();\nlet bad=0;out.forEach((t,i)=>{if(!t.p){bad++;console.log('FAIL',i+1,t.n,t.x);}});\nconsole.log('tests:',out.length-bad,'/',out.length,'passed');\nconst b1=runBenchmark(newGame(1337),200),b2=runBenchmark(newGame(1337),200);\nconsole.log('bench200',JSON.stringify(b1));\nconsole.log('determinism',b1.hash===b2.hash);\n")
EOF
node --check /tmp/full.js && echo "SYNTAX OK" && node /tmp/core.js

tool_input.description: Syntax check and run test suite headlessly
Probe whether running a script path is permitted

claude.result:
`game.html` is written. Summary of what's in it:

**Core** — one `S` state object; mulberry32 PRNG whose 32-bit counter lives *inside* the state (so save/load and the benchmark are bit-identical). Default seed 1337, editable. `resolveTurn()` runs 9 documented phases in fixed order (storm → production → consumption → morale/fatigue → migration → storage clamp → trade/prices → events → turn advance).

**Systems** — 8×8 seeded terrain (ash/rock/water/vent/ruins, smoothed + minimum-feature guarantees); 13 buildings with terrain requirements, adjacency bonuses and per-slot jobs; real chains (ash→soil→food, ore+power→metal, metal+power→parts) with storage caps and logged overflow; individual colonists with name/job/skill 1–5/fatigue/morale, skill growing only in-specialty; 11-node research tree with prereqs; 12 events (5 with genuine tradeoff choices) on 10-turn cooldowns; caravans with limited stock, a scrip purse, drifting global indices and stockpile-sensitive prices; ashstorms on a scaling cadence that damage integrity, spike water use and drain power, mitigated by Windbreaks + Storm Baffles + Sealed Habitats; repairs costing 2 parts and one colonist's labour per turn.

**Dev panel** — "Run Tests" prints 55 pass/fail assertions (no negative resources, caps respected, roster/assignment consistency, prereq enforcement, adjacency arithmetic, morale-zero departure, damage disabling output, trade limits, cooldown ticking, save/load hash round-trip *and* identical continuation, benchmark reproducibility, end conditions, and a source scan proving the built-in random generator is never called). "Run Benchmark" deep-copies the live state, simulates 200 turns with a greedy policy, and prints a state hash plus stats; the panel shows the previous hash and a MATCH/MISMATCH line.

**Verification caveat:** command execution is gated in this environment, so I could not run the suite. I verified statically instead: brace/paren/bracket balance across the file, zero `Math.random`, zero storage/network/external-resource references, and a line-by-line re-read of every system. Several bugs found that way are fixed — notably the source-scan test would have failed on its own comment text, a workshop test used an ash tile the building can't occupy, and the morale-zero test needed a shortage to keep the drift negative. Please click **Run Tests** and **Run Benchmark** twice on first open; that's the check I couldn't perform.
